comment: KOTOR III (fan) Citadel Station docks. Lieutenant Senn of the Telos Security Force clears Seren's shuttle. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: Lieutenant Senn, Telos Security Force. Courier Vaux has filed to depart with a passenger aboard. I take it the passenger is you?
This walkway is for registered dock traffic. If you have no vessel to declare, please keep it clear.
The shuttle passed its inspection this morning, and the clearance fee is in. One last question for the log. Where is it bound?
Only as long as you make it. Every departure gets the same checks while the restoration goes on. I do not skip steps for anyone, courier or captain.
Nar Shaddaa. I will not ask why. Keep your wits about you there, and keep the courier out of trouble. Your shuttle is cleared for departure.
It matters to the log, and the log matters to me. Name a destination, or the shuttle stays clamped to this dock.

replies.text: That's me. We would like to leave today.
Fair enough. Carry on with your checks.
